title: Optical Time Domain Reflectometer (OTDR) Fiber Line Diagnostic SOP
diagnostic_steps: Step 1: Check Optical Network Terminal (ONT) optical receiver power (normal: -8 dBm to -27 dBm).
Step 2: If power < -30 dBm or LOS (Loss of Signal) light flashes red, dispatch automated OTDR pulse test via OSS adapter.
Step 3: Analyze OTDR return trace: A high reflective Fresnel spike with sharp drop-off indicates optical fiber break at distance D meters from Optical Line Terminal (OLT).
Step 4: If fiber break is localized within customer premises drop cable (< 150m), guide customer to check internal fiber patch cord.
Step 5: If fiber break is beyond drop terminal (> 150m), trigger urgent field technician dispatch and issue proactive outage credit.
resolution_criteria: Optical receiver power restored to >= -22 dBm; ONT PON LED solid green.

title: Cellular Network Attachment Error Code 0x4F (ERR_NW_ATTACH_TIMEOUT_0x4F)
symptoms: User handset displays 'No Service' or fails to attach to 5G Standalone (SA) / Non-Standalone (NSA) carrier channel.
root_cause_analysis: Handset radio signaling timer expired while awaiting NAS (Non-Access Stratum) Authentication Response from Unified Data Management (UDM) / Home Subscriber Server (HSS). Commonly triggered by SIM profile desynchronization or localized core cell tower overload.
troubleshooting_steps: 1. Verify customer subscription status and ICCID profile active flag in UDM/HSS.
2. Query local cell tower telemetry for radio frequency (RF) utilization and sector alarms.
3. Trigger an OSS Network Core soft reset on the subscriber's Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN) to purge stale packet-data protocol (PDP) context.
4. Instruct customer to toggle Airplane Mode for 15 seconds to force re-attach handshake.
5. Verify APN settings are configured to 'fast.telco.net' with authentication type PAP/CHAP.

title: VoWiFi & IMS Registration Failure Code (ERR_SIP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE)
symptoms: Unable to initiate or receive Wi-Fi voice calls; calls fail with instantaneous disconnect.
root_cause_analysis: IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) server returned HTTP/SIP 503 indicating temporary overload or IPsec tunnel failure across evolved Packet Data Gateway (ePDG).
troubleshooting_steps: 1. Check if home router blocks UDP ports 500 (IKEv2) and 4500 (IPsec NAT-Traversal).
2. Verify SIM is provisioned with 'VOWIFI_VOICE_CALLING_SVC' entitlement.
3. Perform dynamic subscriber profile refresh on the IMS core via Provisioning Adapter.
4. If persistent, reboot Wi-Fi gateway to clear stale NAT session state.
